## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Distinguish synthetic tests, read-only live checks and real disposable-environment installer tests.

## Maintenance

- [ ] Affected docs and issue acceptance criteria reflect the final behavior.
- [ ] Public fixtures/screenshots contain synthetic or reviewed sanitized data only.
- [ ] Remaining limitations are stated; completed work is linked to its evidence.
- [ ] If this is a release, the release checklist and download links are current.
